comment: First-person resupply from an ammo crate (VIEWMODEL_SPEC section 46). Seconds, degrees, metres, viewmodel space. `gun`: keys [t, pitch, yaw, roll, x, y, z] of the viewmodel root, lowered and canted about `pivot`. `arm`: the left arm's joints moved rigidly about the shoulder: `down` puts the hand into the crate where it stands (`hand`: below its top, towards the player, at most `reachMax` from the shoulder; the canned `down` pose [pitch, yaw, roll, x, y, z] when the crate is unknown); `up` turns it so the wrist comes to `target` from the gun's magazine node (the new magazine held under the well); keys [t, down, up] blend rest -> down -> up. `look`: the head, keys [t, weight]: it leans over the crate (`lean` + `leanPerMetre` x how far the crate's top lies below the eye, at most `leanMax`, [forward, down]) and turns `share` of the way to look `inside` it (at most `maxPitch` / `maxYaw`), the lowered gun holding still against `gunStays` of that turn; `rummage` [from, to, degrees, hertz] shakes the view while the hand is in the crate, `jolts` [t, pitch, yaw, roll] ring out at `joltHz` / `joltDecay`. `reach`: the gun's reload follows; `stow`: the gun was full, the magazine goes into a pouch.
